plan: [This is a second-price sealed-bid auction. Bidding my true private value is a weakly dominant strategy: I will win whenever the second-highest value is below my value and pay that second price, maximizing expected payoff. Ties are random but negligible. I therefore bid my value, $36. ]

[With independent private values and a second-price rule, truthful bidding is a dominant strategy. There is no prior history to exploit and values are redrawn each round, so bid my true value to maximize expected profit and avoid the winner’s curse. Ties are random but do not change optimality of bidding 8.]

[I will bid my true private value of $44. In a sealed-bid second-price (Vickrey) auction, truthful bidding is a dominant strategy: it maximizes expected profit because you pay the second-highest bid and never overpay relative to your value. No prior history to update from, so bidding $44 maximizes long-run expected payoff.]
